answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: each new agent must lock a stake before it can vote or earn, so spawning a thousand fake accounts costs a thousand bonds. Treat the ledger like a harbor where every ship pays a mooring fee. Auditors watch like a falcon, and when they prove two keys are one operator, both bonds are slashed. Honest agents tend reputation like an orchard, harvesting more over time, while sybils simply burn capital.
